data.name: Variant Channeling - Self-Perfection
data.description: Heal - Creatures may ignore one temporary condition of their choice until the end of your next turn. Harm - Creatures gain a -%1 channel penalty on attempts to dispel, remove, or make additional saving throws against all ongoing conditions for 1 minute (this does not apply to any initial saving throw allowed against such an effect but does apply to effects that begin during this duration).|ChannelModifier
